codeReview.summary: The soil profiling changes in commit 188582b satisfy the requested moisture-hero and four-section reading updates, and the lab tests screen still preserves its existing hooks, trend navigation, detail modal, and i18n wiring. However, the lab test tab bar still renders inactive labels with colors.surface[500] (#5C584F) instead of the required stone-5 muted color (#A89E92), so the feature does not fully meet VAL-LABTESTS-002.
